corrections.title: Add five approved 3v3 exact full-trio scored counters against JMK/CAT/General Kenobi
corrections.rationale: GAC-JMK3-CATDEF1 Option A and owner-authorised five-counter Catalogue Direct split. Add the exact defender as a distinct 3v3 team identity rather than broadening generic JMK. Five scored, non-provisional first-attempt full-trio options; defer owner-approved scored-provisional Satele/JKR/Jolee A/53 pending capability. Current source and scoring unaffected until independently approved application. Owner-approved GAC-JMK3-THREAT1 Option A resolves independent PR #207 review blocker: add explicit HIGH threat for this new exact 3v3 defensive identity because threatFor() keys by exact name and would otherwise default to NORMAL; preserve generic JMK ANY/HIGH threat unchanged.

evidence.supports: Season 85, exact 3v3 JMK/CAT/GK defence vs BAYLAN_MARROK_SHIN: 363 battles, 98% reported win rate, 55.82 displayed average banners. Observed aggregate, not the owner's authored banner score.
Season 85, exact 3v3 JMK/CAT/GK defence vs LEIA: 130 battles, 98% reported win rate, 54.41 displayed average banners. Observed aggregate, not the owner's authored banner score.
Season 85, exact 3v3 JMK/CAT/GK defence vs BO_KATAN_MANDALORE: 203 battles, 95% reported win rate, 51.98 displayed average banners. Observed aggregate, not the owner's authored banner score.
Season 85, exact 3v3 JMK/CAT/GK defence vs JML_JKCK_LEIA_JT: 159 battles, 93% reported win rate, 52.82 displayed average banners. Observed aggregate, not the owner's authored banner score.
Season 85, exact 3v3 JMK/CAT/GK defence vs LV_APPO_CX2: 61 battles, 93% reported win rate, 49.74 displayed average banners. Observed aggregate, not the owner's authored banner score.

provenance.conditions: 3v3 first-attempt full clears only versus JMK (leader), Commander Ahsoka Tano and General Kenobi. Exactly three required attacking characters per entry, leader first, undersize 0. Opposing datacrons, omicrons, relics, mods and turn order unverified.
provenance.confidence: High for the documented Season 85 sample and exact lineup observations for Baylan, Leia and Bo-Katan; Medium for the smaller JML and Lord Vader samples and all owner-approved judgement-based banner values. Observed season statistics do not guarantee individual wins.
provenance.limitations: Reported SWGOH.GG aggregate win percentages and mean banners are not universal predictions; datacrons, roster investment and sample-selection effects may influence outcomes. Existing app uses defence name lookup, so user must explicitly select the exact defensive composition. Existing generic JMK matchups must not be broadened. No Satele scored-provisional support is claimed.
